integrity.method: Complete exact immutable Git bytes, independent tree sizes and SHA256/identity checks; private producer source bytes also matched.

notes: Registered manual test, not a weekly scheduled occurrence.
Earlier producer correction versions were preserved privately but not canonically accepted here; no extra investigation or evidence vote.
Publisher bodies/private evidence packages are not part of public transport; data ages, source dependence and missingness remain controlling.
Unavailable-source record timestamps denote status review rather than actual publisher retrieval.

Common publisher alone does not identify shared measurements: gas WNGSR is distinct from petroleum WPSR; shared petroleum inputs are deduplicated. No EIA measurement is established in this run of GEV.
